boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Main Campus spaces for studying, making, support, and low-key recreation, documented by Temple sources.

cards.title: Charles Library 24/7 Study Area
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Polett Street and Liacouras Walk entrance
cards.notes: Use the dedicated study entrance near Polett Street and Liacouras Walk when you need a library workspace outside regular building access.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated around-the-clock study area within Charles Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries identifies a 24/7 study space at the Charles Library entrance near Polett and Liacouras Walks.
cards.source_title: Charles Library: What You Need to Know
cards.access_notes: The 24/7 space is available to current Temple affiliates; check current library notices before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Charles Library 3rd Floor Open Reading Area
cards.title: Third-Floor Open Reading Area
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Main Campus
cards.notes: Choose the third-floor open reading area for a shared reading-and-study setting; bring your own device and use library services as needed.
cards.short_summary: An open, named reading area among Charles Library’s study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries lists the 3rd Floor Open Reading Area among Charles Library’s public spaces.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Charles Library building-access and space-use guidance.

cards.entity_name: Charles Library 4th Floor Quiet Reading Room
cards.title: Fourth-Floor Quiet Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • south side
cards.notes: Settle into the south-side fourth-floor quiet reading room for focused individual work, and keep conversation and calls elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study room on Charles Library’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries states that quiet study is available in the fourth-floor reading room on the south side.
cards.source_title: Charles Library: What You Need to Know
cards.access_notes: Quiet-study expectations apply; check current building access before going.

cards.title: Charles Library Terrace
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Main Campus
cards.notes: Add the library terrace to a study break or gathering plan, and confirm access conditions with the library before heading up.
cards.short_summary: A named terrace included in Charles Library’s public-space listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries lists the Terrace as one of Charles Library’s public spaces.
cards.access_notes: Access may vary with library operations or events; verify locally.

cards.title: Loretta C. Duckworth Scholars Studio
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Main Campus
cards.notes: Explore a workshop, consultation, or reservable studio space when a project calls for digital methods, research support, or collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A Charles Library studio for digital scholarship and collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scholars Studio supports consultations, workshops, and collaborative research in digital humanities, arts, cultural analytics, and critical making.
cards.access_notes: Specific studio spaces can be reserved online; availability and eligibility may vary.

cards.entity_name: Loretta C. Duckworth Scholars Studio Makerspace
cards.title: Duckworth Scholars Studio Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Rooms 314 and 315
cards.notes: Use the Makerspace for a hands-on project by checking its policies, equipment guidance, and any required reservation or workshop details first.
cards.short_summary: A named making space within the Duckworth Scholars Studio.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries reports that the expanded Makerspace is on Charles Library’s third floor in Rooms 314 and 315.
cards.access_notes: Consult current Makerspace policies and reservation information before using equipment.

cards.title: Watch the BookBot at Charles
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Main Campus
cards.notes: Request an item through the library system, then build in a moment to see the automated retrieval system that supports pickup.
cards.short_summary: Charles Library’s automated storage-and-retrieval system for library materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Libraries identifies BookBot as Charles Library’s Automated Storage and Retrieval System, from which items can be pulled for pickup.
cards.access_notes: Library borrowing and pickup policies apply; ask the One Stop desk for help.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Charles Library • Room 230
cards.notes: Use drop-in or appointment-based academic support when you want help connecting tutoring, coaching, and other success resources.
cards.short_summary: A Charles Library hub for academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple’s Graduate School directs students to the Student Success Center in Charles Library Room 230 for drop-in, appointment, and email sessions.
cards.access_notes: Service formats and availability vary; use the Student Success Center’s current scheduling information.

cards.entity_name: Howard Gittis Student Center Game Room
cards.title: Howard Gittis Student Center Game Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center South • first floor
cards.notes: Plan a low-key break with pool, ping-pong, video games, or board games; check the Student Center for current operating details.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center recreation room with several casual games.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Student Affairs describes the HGSC Game Room as offering pool, ping-pong, video games, and board games.
cards.access_notes: Student Center hours and Game Room availability change by term; verify before visiting.

cards.title: HGSC Cinema
cards.subtitle: Howard Gittis Student Center • Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the Student Center’s programming for a film showing, then use the cinema as a campus-centered option for a group movie night.
cards.short_summary: A cozy campus cinema operated through the Howard Gittis Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Student Affairs identifies the HGSC Cinema as a Student Center space for screenings of blockbusters and classic films.
cards.access_notes: Screenings and access depend on current Student Center programming and hours.
